def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i in range(h):
        row=g[i]
        for c in set(row)-{0}:
            js=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==c]
            for j in range(min(js),max(js)+1):
                if row[j]==0: row[j]=c
    for j in range(w):
        col=[g[i][j] for i in range(h)]
        i=0
        while i<h:
            if col[i]!=0:
                c=col[i]; i0=i
                while i<h and col[i]==c: i+=1
                i1=i-1
                # upward
                if any(col[k]!=0 for k in range(i0)):
                    k=i0-1
                    while k>=0 and col[k]==0: g[k][j]=c; k-=1
                # downward
                if any(col[k]!=0 for k in range(i1+1,h)):
                    k=i1+1
                    while k<h and col[k]==0: g[k][j]=c; k+=1
            else: i+=1
    return g
